column3: Hey there! How are you doing today?

Google is an American multinational technology company that specializes in Internet-related services and products such as search engines, advertising technologies, cloud computing, software for businesses, mobile apps, online ads, and hardware like laptops, smartphones, and tablets. It was founded by Larry Page and Sergey Brin while they were PhD students at Stanford University in California in 1998.

ChatGPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) is an open-source language model developed by OpenAI that uses pre-trained transformer models to generate human-like text responses in various domains such as natural language processing, machine translation, and dialogue systems.
